findings.quote: The string over the top fixed pulley runs from point 1 to the pulley labelled 3
findings.note: In the served figure the string S₁ over P₁ runs to the axle of P₂, whose position is x₃; the pulley labelled P₃ is the small one at x₄. "The pulley labelled 3" names the wrong pulley; the equation beside it (x₁ + x₃) is right.
findings.fix: The string over the top fixed pulley P₁ runs from block 1 to the axle of pulley P₂ (position x₃), so their distances from the reference line add to a constant.

findings.quote: The string over pulley 3 runs from point 1 to pulley 4, both measured relative to pulley 3's own position.
findings.note: The served figure has pulleys P₂ (axle x₃) and P₃ (axle x₄); the string meant here is S₂ over P₂, running to the axle of P₃. "Pulley 3" and "pulley 4" do not match the figure's labels, and "pulley 3" reads as P₃, the wrong pulley.
findings.fix: The string S₂ over pulley P₂ (axle at x₃) runs from block 1 to the axle of pulley P₃ (at x₄), both measured relative to P₂'s own position.

findings.quote: The string over pulley 4 runs from point 1 to block 2, both measured relative to pulley 4's own position.
findings.note: There is no pulley 4 in the served figure; the string meant is S₃ over P₃ (axle at x₄).
findings.fix: The string S₃ over pulley P₃ (axle at x₄) runs from block 1 to block 2, both measured relative to P₃'s own position.

notes: All three constraint equations, the substitutions and the final relation are correct; the defect is only that the prose numbers the pulleys by their position index (3, 4) instead of the figure's labels (P₂, P₃).
